industry.key: K. Professional, business and consumer services
industry.why: Neutral, carried unchanged by judgement; see component 1, Special topics, Topic 1 (Recruitment Services). Component 1 regime, 2-Oct-26 (rates-led late cycle, hiking path marked down for the first time this week, growth firm at the level and rolling at the margin, index calm with risk-off running beneath it through breadth, size and rate sensitivity, not through defensives; sources present 2026-W40): the industry's composite rank (66, from 20 on 3-Jul) is a relief rally in the artificial-intelligence-exposed labour-service names measured by a composite weighted to the last six months, with the twelve-month return still -6.94% against the index; the seven sectors are split (Recruitment D, Advertising C, Testing B, the rest C) and the sector rows carry the view. Relative strength C now, C prior. Counter-case: if the recruiters' rebound is the early-cycle hiring turn, this industry leads and C is late.

sector.why: Overweight, from Neutral; see component 1, Special topics, Topic 1 (Recruitment Services), which carries the same letter. Component 1 regime, 2-Oct-26 (rates-led late cycle, hiking path marked down for the first time this week, growth firm at the level and rolling at the margin, index calm with risk-off running beneath it through breadth, size and rate sensitivity, not through defensives; sources present 2026-W40): regulated, recurring, non-discretionary demand from large proven cases (the simple, trustworthy case the regime rewards), and the one sector in its industry whose rise did not come from a floor: twelve-month relative return +9.0%, composite rank 66 on 3-Jul to 79 on 1-Oct. Relative strength B now, C prior, agrees. Counter-case: four stocks, one in the Pool (Intertek, sell-side momentum D), and testing volumes follow industrial activity if the margin keeps rolling over.

geography.why: Double Underweight, carried on a stale reading, said plainly: the French premium (a record 150 basis points on 26 October) was not re-read, no source spoke to France, and the conditions (to D under 120 basis points for a month; to C under 100) could not be tested. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). TotalEnergies is 36th on the starting score with a global revenue base the row does not describe well. Counter-case: Moody's affirmation and the contrarian set-up in French small and mid caps. A week without a spread reading is not a reason to lift a row set on one; re-test when the premium is read.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
